description: Retrieval fixture (docs/PLAN.md §8a). 25 cases: 20 answerable, 5 abstention. Each case has its own history (sessions of user/assistant messages, with distractor turns), a question, and either expect_any (one of these substrings must appear in the top-1 result, case-insensitive) or abstain=true (no result may be returned above the backend's threshold). Plus 10 contradiction pairs (§8d): after ingesting before and after, the top result for the question must contain a current substring and none of the obsolete ones.
